title: Exploring Potential Biomarkers and Molecular Mechanisms of Ischemic Cardiomyopathy and COVID-19 Comorbidity Based on Bioinformatics and Systems Biology.
authors: Luo, Simin; Zhang, Xuan; Xiao, Xiang; Luo, Wenting; Yang, Zixuan; Tang, Songqi; Huang, Wei
one_liner_zh: 基于生物信息学分析缺血性心肌病与COVID-19共病标志物，含转录因子调控网络和分子对接，但核心非蛋白质-DNA互作机制研究，方法以表达组学为主。
abstract: Cardiovascular complications combined with COVID-19 (SARS-CoV-2) lead to a poor prognosis in patients. The common pathogenesis of ischemic cardiomyopathy (ICM) and COVID-19 is still unclear. Here, we explored potential molecular mechanisms and biomarkers for ICM and COVID-19. Common differentially expressed genes (DEGs) of ICM (GSE5406) and COVID-19 (GSE164805) were identified using GEO2R. We performed enrichment and protein-protein interaction analyses and screened key genes. To confirm the diagnostic performance for these hub genes, we used external datasets (GSE116250 and GSE211979) and plotted ROC curves. Transcription factor and microRNA regulatory networks were constructed for the validated hub genes. Finally, drug prediction and molecular docking validation were performed using cMAP. We identified 81 common DEGs, many of which were enriched in terms of their relation to angiogenesis. Three DEGs were identified as key hub genes (HSP90AA1, HSPA9, and SRSF1) in the protein-protein interaction analysis. These hub genes had high diagnostic performance in the four datasets (AUC > 0.7). Mir-16-5p and KLF9 transcription factor co-regulated these hub genes. The drugs vindesine and ON-01910 showed good binding performance to the hub genes. We identified HSP90AA1, HSPA9, and SRSF1 as markers for the co-pathogenesis of ICM and COVID-19, and showed that co-pathogenesis of ICM and COVID-19 may be related to angiogenesis. Vindesine and ON-01910 were predicted as potential therapeutic agents. Our findings will contribute to a deeper understanding of the comorbidity of ICM with COVID-19.
abstract_zh: 心血管并发症合并COVID-19（SARS-CoV-2）导致患者预后不良。缺血性心肌病（ICM）与COVID-19的共同发病机制仍不清楚。在此，我们探讨了ICM和COVID-19的潜在分子机制和生物标志物。利用GEO2R识别了ICM（GSE5406）和COVID-19（GSE164805）的共同差异表达基因（DEGs）。我们进行了富集分析和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用分析，并筛选了关键基因。为确认这些枢纽基因的诊断性能，我们使用了外部数据集（GSE116250和GSE211979）并绘制了ROC曲线。针对验证后的枢纽基因，构建了转录因子和microRNA调控网络。最后，使用cMAP进行了药物预测和分子对接验证。我们识别出81个共同DEGs，其中许多在血管生成相关方面富集。在蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用分析中，三个DEGs被确定为关键枢纽基因（HSP90AA1、HSPA9和SRSF1）。这些枢纽基因在四个数据集中具有较高的诊断性能（AUC > 0.7）。Mir-16-5p和KLF9转录因子共同调控这些枢纽基因。药物长春地辛和ON-01910对枢纽基因表现出良好的结合性能。我们确定了HSP90AA1、HSPA9和SRSF1作为ICM和COVID-19共同发病的标志物，并表明ICM和COVID-19的共同发病可能与血管生成有关。长春地辛和ON-01910被预测为潜在的治疗药物。我们的发现将有助于更深入地理解ICM与COVID-19的共病性。
